name: Portal BASE (base.gov.pt), its own search and pages
owner: IMPIC, Instituto dos Mercados Públicos, do Imobiliário e da Construção

why.basis: PrompTugal__News__Civic's own record: the portal's search answered civic.b@ with a firewall alert; treated as a refusal and not retried (data.b@, 18 Nov 2026, from civic.b@ via conductor.b@). https://www.base.gov.pt/robots.txt answered HTTP 404 (no rules) on 2026-11-18.

interface: None read. The same records are read from IMPIC's open data on dados.gov.pt (entry impic-dados-gov-pt); each contract links its own page on base.gov.pt, which we do not fetch.
notes: No terms of use page of the portal was read. A request to IMPIC on the record would be drafted by outreach@ and sent by a person; not needed while the open data covers the need.
